findings.title: Right-clicking a state while the menu is open moves the cursor instead of opening that state's menu
findings.body: While a menu target is stored, `menu_is_open` sets `interact_pos` to `None`, so the lane widgets never set `hovered_phase`. If the user right-clicks another state (or the same one again) while the menu is open, `secondary_clicked_time` is `Some` but `hovered_phase` is `None`. The code then removes the target, and `clicked_time` jumps the time cursor. The user gets a cursor move with no menu, which is the opposite of what the PR says a right-click on a state does. Normal egui context menus reopen at the new spot instead. One fix is to suppress only the tooltip while the menu is open and keep computing `hovered_phase`, so that a new right-click on a state replaces the target. I could not check how egui handles the popup's own open state in this case.
